title: Mixed Conditionals
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Los Mixed Conditionals son la prueba definitiva de agilidad mental en inglés. Al poder combinar causas pasadas con efectos presentes (o viceversa), logras una precisión analítica indispensable para evaluar estrategias y escenarios en el nivel corporativo más alto.

parts.visual:
Los Mixed Conditionals combinan el 2º y 3er condicional cuando la condición y el resultado ocurren en tiempos diferentes.

1. Pasado Irreal -> Efecto Presente: 
(Si algo hubiera ocurrido en el pasado, el presente sería diferente). 
Estructura: If + Past Perfect, ... would + infinitivo. 
Ej: If we HAD INVESTED in Apple in 2005 (causa pasada), we WOULD BE billionaires now (efecto presente). 
Ej: If I HADN'T FORGOTTEN my passport, I WOULD BE on the plane right now.
parts.audio: Welcome to Mixed Conditionals. These combine the second and third conditionals when the condition and result happen at different times. Type 1 is: Unreal Past Condition with a Present Result. If something had happened differently in the past, the present would be different. The structure is: If plus Past Perfect, then 'would' plus base verb. For example: If we HAD INVESTED in Apple in 2005, we WOULD BE billionaires now. Or: If I HADN'T FORGOTTEN my passport, I WOULD BE on the plane right now.

parts.visual:
2. Condición Presente Irreal -> Efecto Pasado: 
(Si un hecho general/presente fuera diferente, el pasado habría cambiado). 
Estructura: If + Past Simple, ... would have + participio pasado. 
Ej: If I DIDN'T SPEAK French (condición presente/general), they WOULDN'T HAVE HIRED me last year (efecto pasado). 
Ej: If she WERE a better negotiator (condición general), she WOULD HAVE CLOSED the deal yesterday. 

Recuerda: 
- Pasado afecta Presente: If + Had done, ... would do. 
- Presente afecta Pasado: If + Did, ... would have done.
parts.audio: Type 2 is: Unreal Present Condition with a Past Result. If a general or present fact were different, the past would have changed. The structure is: If plus Past Simple, then 'would have' plus past participle. For example: If I DIDN'T SPEAK French generally, they WOULDN'T HAVE HIRED me last year. Or: If she WERE a better negotiator, she WOULD HAVE CLOSED the deal yesterday. Remember the two mixes: Past affecting Present is 'If I had done, I would be'. Present affecting Past is 'If I did, I would have done'.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta del Mixed Conditional.

questions.question: If they had accepted our offer last month, we ____ the market leaders right now. (Pasado afecta Presente)
questions.explanation: If had accepted (pasado) -> we would be now (presente).

questions.question: If I wasn't afraid of flying, I ____ the job in London years ago. (Presente general afecta Pasado)
questions.explanation: If I wasn't (presente general) -> I would have taken (pasado).

questions.question: If we ____ the software yesterday, it would be working properly today.
questions.explanation: If we had updated (ayer) -> it would be working (hoy).

questions.question: I would have called you yesterday if I ____ your phone number. (Hecho general).
questions.explanation: If I had it (en general, hoy y siempre) -> I would have called you yesterday.

questions.question: If the CEO ____ not wasted the budget last year, we wouldn't be bankrupt today.
questions.explanation: If the CEO had not wasted (pasado) -> wouldn't be (presente).

questions.question: If you ____ more attention in yesterday's meeting, you would know what to do now.
questions.explanation: If you had paid attention (ayer) -> you would know (ahora).

questions.question: If he ____ so arrogant, he wouldn't have insulted the client during yesterday's dinner. (Rasgo de personalidad general).
questions.explanation: If he weren't arrogant (en general) -> he wouldn't have insulted (ayer).

questions.question: If we hadn't missed the flight, we ____ sitting on the beach right now.
questions.explanation: If we hadn't missed (pasado) -> we would be sitting (ahora).

questions.question: If they ____ a reliable supplier, they wouldn't have delayed our shipment last week. (Hecho general).
questions.explanation: If they were reliable (en general) -> they wouldn't have delayed (pasado).

questions.question: I would be a millionaire now if I ____ that startup in 2010.
questions.explanation: If I had bought (2010) -> I would be (ahora).

questions.question: If she ____ German fluently, she wouldn't have struggled during the negotiations in Berlin last year.
questions.explanation: If she spoke German (habilidad general) -> she wouldn't have struggled (pasado).

questions.question: If we had hired him back then, our department ____ in complete chaos right now.
questions.explanation: If we had hired him (pasado) -> wouldn't be (ahora).

questions.question: If I didn't trust you completely, I ____ you the security codes yesterday.
questions.explanation: If I didn't trust you (general) -> wouldn't have given (ayer).

questions.question: If the company had filed for bankruptcy in 2008, it ____ today.
questions.explanation: If it had filed (pasado) -> wouldn't exist (hoy).

questions.question: If he ____ better qualified, they would have promoted him months ago. (Situación general).
questions.explanation: If he were better qualified (general) -> would have promoted (pasado).

questions.question: We ____ still trying to fix the bug if you hadn't found the solution.
questions.explanation: If you hadn't found (pasado) -> we would be (ahora).

questions.question: If my car wasn't so old, it ____ down on the highway yesterday.
questions.explanation: If it wasn't old (general) -> wouldn't have broken down (ayer).

questions.question: If I had saved more money in my twenties, I ____ a house now.
questions.explanation: If I had saved (pasado) -> would own (ahora).

questions.question: If they ____ the instructions properly, the machine wouldn't be broken right now.
questions.explanation: If they had followed (pasado) -> wouldn't be broken (ahora).

questions.question: If she wasn't the CEO's daughter, she ____ that executive position straight out of college.
questions.explanation: If she wasn't the daughter (hecho general) -> wouldn't have gotten the job (pasado).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el verbo en la forma correcta del Mixed Conditional.

questions.question: If I had studied yesterday, I ____ pass the test now. (Usa: would)
questions.explanation: would pass.

questions.question: If I were rich (now), I would ____ bought that car yesterday. (Usa: have)
questions.explanation: would have bought.

questions.question: If we ____ invested in 2010, we would be rich today. (Usa: had)
questions.explanation: had invested.

questions.question: If he ____ not so arrogant, he wouldn't have shouted yesterday. (Usa: were/was)
questions.explanation: were.

questions.question: We ____ be lost right now if you hadn't brought the map. (Usa: would)
questions.explanation: would be.

questions.question: If I spoke French, I would ____ translated the document last week. (Usa: have)
questions.explanation: have translated.

questions.question: If you ____ listened to me yesterday, you wouldn't be in trouble now. (Usa: had)
questions.explanation: had listened.

questions.question: If it hadn't rained last night, the grass wouldn't ____ wet now. (Usa: be)
questions.explanation: wouldn't be.

questions.question: If I ____ (know) her phone number, I would have called her yesterday.
questions.explanation: If I knew (general).

questions.question: If she had taken her medication, she ____ feel better now. (Usa: would)
questions.explanation: would feel.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: If I had invested, I would be rich.
options: If I had invested, I would be rich.
If I invested, I would be rich.
If I had invested, I would have been rich.
If I invest, I will be rich.
questions.correct_answer: If I had invested, I would be rich.
questions.explanation: Audio exacto (Pasado -> Presente).
